title: Recommendation of Suhoor (Pre-Dawn Meal)
description: Emphasizing the importance of partaking in the pre-dawn meal, even if it is small, citing the Prophet's (s) narration that Allah and His angels bless those who eat Suhoor.

phrases.arabic: وقال صلى الله عليه و آله:
phrases.english: And he (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

phrases.arabic: إنّ اللَّهَ وَمَلائِكَتَهُ يُصَلُّونَ عَلَى الْمُسْتَغفِرينَ وَالْمُتَسَحِّرِيْنَ بِالْأَسْحارِ،
phrases.english: Verily, Allah and His angels send blessings upon those who seek forgiveness and those who partake in the pre-dawn meal during the hours before dawn.
phrases.transliteration: Innallāha wa malā’ikatahu yuṣallūna ‘alal-mustaghfirīna wal-mutasaḥḥirīna bil-asḥār.

phrases.english: Partake of the pre-dawn meal, even if it be with but a few sips of water.
